## Clinical justification

This patient has iron deficiency anaemia on routine blood testing, with a low haemoglobin and low ferritin. I have investigated for an upper GI source and found none. A coeliac screen returned negative two months ago. There is no clear dietary cause. He also reports a change in bowel habit over the past two months. I believe a lower GI investigation is warranted to exclude a colorectal source.
